source_requirement: Build a hospital management system where doctors manage appointments, patients register and view medical history, and admins manage users.

data.project_summary: Hospital Management System for doctors, patients, and admins

features.name: Appointment Management
features.description: Doctors can schedule and manage appointments for patients

features.name: Patient Registration
features.description: Patients can register and view their medical history

features.name: User Management
features.description: Admins can manage user accounts and permissions

user_stories.benefit: Improve patient care and reduce no-shows

user_stories.goal: View and manage my medical history
user_stories.benefit: Take control of my health and well-being

user_stories.goal: Manage user accounts and permissions effectively
user_stories.benefit: Ensure secure and efficient hospital operations

assumptions: All users will have a unique login ID and password
Doctors will have access to patient medical history
Admins will have full control over user accounts and permissions
open_questions: How will we integrate with existing hospital systems?
What are the security measures to protect patient data?
How will we handle user authentication and authorization?
